title: AgentFence audit event
description: A single newline-delimited JSON record written to an AgentFence audit log. Produced by `agentfence check`, `agentfence proxy`, and `agentfence proxy-http`. See docs/audit-event-schema.md.

schema_version.description: Audit event schema version. Current writers emit "3".

seq.description: Monotonic 1-based sequence number within the session.

timestamp.description: Event time in RFC 3339 / RFC 3339 Nano (UTC).

call_id.description: Identifier of the evaluated tool call. Synthetic 'line-N' for parse-error events.

tool.description: Tool name that was evaluated. Empty for parse-error events.

arguments.description: Redacted tool-call arguments. Present only when argument logging is enabled.

mode.description: Evaluation mode marker. Present only for simulated (dry-run) events.

prev_hash.description: Hex SHA-256 of the previous event in a tamper-evident chain. Empty/absent on the first event of a chain (chain root).

hash.description: Hex SHA-256 of this event's canonical encoding (with hash and signature cleared). Present only in tamper-evident mode.

signature.description: Base64 Ed25519 signature over the event's canonical digest. Present only when signing is enabled. Authenticates the writer.

memoryWriteSummary.description: Safe-to-log summary of a durable memory-write tool call. Never includes the raw payload.

field.description: Argument key that held the durable payload.

size_bytes.description: Byte length of the payload as evaluated.

content_fingerprint.description: Short SHA-256 prefix of the payload for de-duplication; never reveals contents.

patterns_matched.description: Redaction-pattern names that matched the payload.
